proofPassages.scope: Finite-dimensional norming support extension and common supports; continuous unique radial contact and radius bounds.
Inverse sign change, uniform q Lipschitz estimate, unit representatives, ultrapower quotient, completion, global bounds and attained maximum.
Return map, support propagation, positive coefficients, dense combinations, invariant closed convex C, radius-refined finite covers and uniform chi contraction.
Secant and every-support bounds; both cases, explicit inverse configuration, compact finite-dimensional support limit, final convexity/sphere-distance contradiction.
All-radius metric extension, onto property, midpoint defect doubling, additivity, real homogeneity, uniqueness.
